body: A paused ROOT session queue (sends return notificationDisposition "heldBehindPausedQueue") is resumed by an agent with POST /api/sessions/<session-id>/queue/resume against the TermAl host. Read back the state: the session should show active and queuePaused=false. Greg said agents may send this themselves (relayed by Engram::Advisor, TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #2939, 2026-10-31 22:56Z, which applied it to session-12325). termal_resume_session is a different thing: it resumes held DELEGATIONS only. Record each occurrence on w-f23a694c9bc5 so the underlying pause gets fixed.
